title: Tag SRD focus symbol instrument and tool equipment groups
description:
Child of the equipment grouping audit epic.

The SRD equipment section groups several leaf items into gameplay-relevant item groups such as arcane focus, druidic focus, holy symbol, musical instrument, artisan tools, gaming sets, and similar tool/equipment categories. The generated records preserve the leaf items but do not carry enough structured group/subtype metadata for deterministic starting-equipment filters.

Examples:
- Arcane focus candidates: Crystal, Orb, Rod, Staff, Wand.
- Holy symbol candidates: Amulet, Emblem, Reliquary.
- Druidic focus candidates: Sprig of mistletoe, Totem, Wooden staff, Yew wand.
- Musical instrument candidates: Bagpipes, Drum, Dulcimer, Flute, Lute, Lyre, Horn, Pan flute, Shawm, Viol.

Acceptance criteria:
- Generated equipment/tool records carry structured group/subtype tags for all SRD groups used by starting equipment, class proficiencies, or background/tool choices.
- select: "arcane-focus", "druidic-focus", "holy-symbol", and "musical-instrument" filters resolve without name/prose heuristics.
- Preserve source provenance for the grouping semantics.
- Add regression tests for each focus/symbol/instrument group and at least one non-focus tool group.
close_reason: Tagged 41 items across 6 named SRD equipment groups (arcane/druidic focus, holy symbol, artisan's tools, gaming set, musical instrument) with structured equipmentGroup
